title: Libra: your next
two months.
summary: Every day feels like a small fight, and your friends are your secret weapon. What is moving for a Libra Moon between now and late January, and the dates to plan around.
film: Libra: your next 2 months in 60 seconds
imageAlt: Maya holding a Libra flag, with a set of scales beside her
inside: Daily life, friends, home and work, each with what is happening and why
The dates between now and late January that matter
Four things to do with this stretch
intro: If you are a Libra by Moon sign, the next two months can feel like a long list of small battles. The chores pile up, deadlines arrive in groups, and there always seems to be one person at work who makes things harder than they need to be. You are not imagining it, and you are not doing anything wrong.

The same stretch carries real support. The people around you are read as unusually helpful until late January, and the slow pressure on your days is, in the tradition, one of the more useful kinds of pressure there is. Three dates change the picture: December 5, December 10 and January 24.

sections.label: Daily life
title: Small fights,
real stamina.
paragraphs: The slowest, most serious influence in the sky sits in your house of daily battles: routine, work, chores, health habits and the people you compete with. It is read as a heavy, grinding time for the day to day. Nothing comes for free, and things that used to take an hour now seem to take an afternoon.

Here is the part people miss. The tradition counts this house as one of the best places for that slow influence to sit. It is read as the stretch in which you quietly outlast every obstacle: rivals lose interest, problems that have been dragging get dealt with one at a time, and the habits you build now tend to stick for years.

It has also been moving backwards, which shows up as tasks that have to be done twice and plans that keep sliding. On December 10 it turns forward again. The grind does not stop that day, but it starts to feel like progress instead of repetition.

sections.label: Friends
title: Your people
show up.
paragraphs: The planet of luck and growth is in your house of friends, gains and wishes until January 23. It is read as a warm stretch for your circle: people offer help, introductions come through, groups and communities go well, and a wish you have mentioned out loud has a better chance than usual of being heard.

Libra tends to be the friend who helps, not the friend who asks. This is the season to turn that around. From December 12 this same influence slows down and appears to move backwards for a while, so the first few weeks are the easiest time to reach out, and the weeks after are better for reconnecting with people you have lost touch with.

sections.label: Home
title: An itch to
change your space.
paragraphs: Until December 4 a restless, hungry influence sits in your house of joy and romance, read as sudden crushes and creative obsessions. On December 5 it moves into your house of home, and it stays there well beyond these two months.

At home it is read as an itch for change: rearranging rooms, repainting, buying the new sofa, or seriously wondering whether you want to live somewhere else. Some of that is healthy. The usual advice is to change the space a little at a time and give any big decision about moving a few weeks before you commit.

sections.label: Work
title: A new chapter
from late January.
paragraphs: On the same day, December 5, a calmer, more detached influence moves into your house of career. It is read as less attachment to titles and praise, and more interest in work that actually means something to you. If a role has started to feel hollow, you may notice it more clearly now.

On January 24 the planet of luck leaves your house of friends and steps into your house of career too. It is read as work asking more of you, with room to grow into it. The friendships you strengthen before then are often the ones that open doors after it.

rows.note: In your house of deep change. Let something old finish without a fight.
Restlessness moves from romance to home; work starts to feel less like a race.
In your house of money. A good day to set a simple budget for the holidays.
Daily battles start to feel like progress instead of repeats.
In your house of travel and learning. Plan a trip or a course for the new year.
In your house of courage and messages. Send the email you have been putting off.
Support leaves your circle of friends and turns towards your career.

steps.name: Pick one battle a day
steps.text: Write down the single thing that most needs doing each morning and do that first. The rest can wait. It is the simplest way to work with a slow, heavy stretch instead of against it.

steps.name: Call a friend for the rest
steps.text: Your circle is the best supported part of your life until late January. Ask for the favour, the introduction or the hand with the move. People are more willing than you think.

steps.name: Change your home in small steps
steps.text: From December 5 the urge to redo your space will be strong. Start with one room or one corner, and give any decision about moving a few weeks.

steps.name: Restart what stalled after December 10
steps.text: If a routine, a project or a health habit fell apart in the autumn, the weeks after the 10th are the better time to pick it up again.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Libra Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Libra. Many people with a Libra Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.

faq.q: Why is a hard stretch called one of the best placements?
faq.a: In the tradition, the slow planet of discipline is read as most useful in the houses of effort and competition. It still feels heavy, but it is read as the kind of pressure that makes you stronger and wears down whatever is in your way.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
